# Site check (night): mychata.cz, 14 Oct 2026

This is the third site check today, run at about 22:30 UTC. The earlier ones are `2026-10-14-site-check.md` and `2026-10-14-site-check-2.md`. The check was read-only: nobody signed in, no forms were submitted, no buttons were clicked and no data was changed. The invalid links used made-up tokens, not any cottage's real links.

## Summary

- 6 of 6 e2e smoke tests pass.
- None of the 5 pages has console errors, page errors or failed first-party requests.
- The seasonal photo loads from `/assets/`, and all page titles are Czech.
- The live commit cannot be read any more. The `data-commit-sha` attribute seen in the evening check has gone with Lovable's `/__l5e/` script tag. The main bundle has changed since then (`index-BTjrpVd9.js` → `index-B_iZbIFo.js`), so there has been a publish after `9f801e8`.
- The cookie banner touches the bottom edge, but its card is inset by 12px, so it looks like it floats. This was measured with a simulated EU response.
- `/host/x-…` has a layout shift (CLS) of 0.11, just above the 0.1 limit.

| `/verejne/zadost/x`       | 200    | none   | "Tento odkaz na formulář neplatí." The fallback heading "Firemní chata" is shown above it (see below); title "Žádost o pobyt — My Chata"  |

The only failed request on any page was the Google Analytics beacon (`g/collect`, `ERR_ABORTED`), which this check ignores. No response was 4xx or 5xx.

| Cookie banner at 375px sits at the bottom edge        | Partly  | The banner shows only when the consent server function returns `required: true`, and from this US runner (Cloudflare IAD) it returned `required: false`. The response was rewritten in the test browser only, to CZ and `required: true`. The wrapper `[data-consent-banner]` is `position: fixed; bottom: 0`, full width, box bottom 812 against a viewport height of 812. The visible card, however, sits inside the wrapper's `p-3` (`src/lib/consent.tsx:111`) and has `rounded-[28px]` on every corner (line 113). Its bottom is at 799, so it looks like it floats about 12px above the edge. To make it sit on the edge on mobile, remove the bottom padding and the bottom corner radius below `md`. The banner also covers about 47% of the screen (382px of 812), and the text of the "Jen nezbytné" button wraps onto two lines. |
| Page titles Czech (L-5c)                              | Pass    | All five titles are Czech, as listed above.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |

The biggest resources are `chata-autumn-DIt40PoD.webp` (379 KB) and `index-B_iZbIFo.js` (181 KB transferred). INP was not measured, because no clicks were made. These numbers are not a DevTools trace.

## Smaller findings

- `/verejne/zadost/x` shows the fallback name "Firemní chata" above the "neplatí" message (`src/routes/verejne.zadost.$token.tsx:141`). No data leaks, but on an invalid link it suggests that a cottage was found.
- The browser bundle writes to `consent_log` directly through Supabase. This is expected with B-002, but it is worth keeping in mind for the RLS auditor.
- The 379 KB hero photo is still large for a 375px screen.

## E2E output

The DevTools MCP was not available, and `node_modules` is not installed in this cloud copy, so `bun run e2e` could not run as it stands. The repo's `tests/e2e/public.spec.ts` and `playwright.config.ts` were copied unchanged into a scratch folder. Only the import (`playwright/test`) and the Chromium path were changed, and the tests ran with `E2E_BASE_URL=https://mychata.cz`:
